description:
Three review agents (OTP conventions, code quality + efficiency, port fidelity + tests) flagged 5 blockers, ~10 warnings, and a bag of nits across the Phase 1 + OAuth + extraction + telemetry work. Knock them all out before Phase 2 (octo-z1d) so the agent kernel builds on clean bones — the Producer pattern in particular will compound through Session/Loop/Tools.

TDD approach throughout:
- Behavior tickets: write the failing test first, then implement.
- Refactor tickets: ensure existing test coverage stays green; add regression tests for any invariant the refactor might break.

DoD: mix check green across umbrella, `mix ai.demo` still works end-to-end against real Anthropic via Claude Code OAuth, all child tickets closed.

comments.text: All 10 subtickets closed. 5 review blockers addressed (Producer refactor, :aborted stop reason, SSE finalize, ETS registry, parse_streaming doc), 4 warnings fixed (telemetry namespace + logger helper, dead fields, Event file collapse, scaffold cleanup), plus the test coverage gaps. Final: 192 tests, 2 excluded. mix check green. mix ai.demo live against real Anthropic verified (23 input / 77 output / stop :stop on the pong test). Ready for Phase 2 (octo-z1d).

title: [EPIC] Post-review cleanup: OTP idiom, fidelity, test gaps
